resources.string: Scales touchpad movement using the saved mouse sensitivity. Changes are saved immediately and used when you return.
On: swipe up to scroll down. Content follows your fingers. Applies to touchpad gestures, not the labeled scroll buttons.
Off: swipe up to scroll up. Content moves opposite your fingers. Applies to touchpad gestures, not the labeled scroll buttons.
Press Enter on the computer after sending text.
Empty the text box after Send.
Typing always requires Send. Editing text never sends keystrokes. The old instant-send choice remains stored for compatibility but is not used.

Global SSH key authentication, passphrase and document import; session startup, shell and input tool; drag delays. Authentication, shell and startup command changes apply on a later connection; Settings does not connect or disconnect.
Reorder actions from the hamburger menu → Layouts & actions → Advanced editor. The old main-grid lock choice remains stored for compatibility but does not control this editor.
